name: Kira Marie Peter-Hansen - Après le § 16 - Am 8
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: 16a. Stresses that the use of escape clauses should not be limited to defence spending; considers that external and temporary shocks can occur in a variety of policy areas and sees no justification for limiting the use of escape clauses to a single domain; highlights that this could apply, in particular, to major public health crises, ecological disasters or other systemic emergencies requiring exceptional and rapid public investment;
